from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

def add_text_to_image(image_path, text, position=(10, 10), font_size=24, color=(255, 0, 0)): #Red text
    """
    Adds text to an image.

    Args:
        image_path: Path to the image file.
        text: The text to add.
        position: The (x, y) coordinates of the top-left corner of the text.
        font_size: The size of the font.
        color: The color of the text (RGB tuple).
    """
    try:
        img = Image.open(image_path)
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        font = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", font_size)  # You may need to adjust the font path
        draw.text(position, text, font=font, fill=color)
        img.save("modified_image.jpg")
        print("Image modified successfully!")
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"Error: Image file not found at {image_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

# Example Usage:
# 1. Replace 'original_image.jpg' with the path to your image.
